page.heading: Contract Price Schedules
page.caption: Date-windowed pricing layered on top of a supplier contract for multi-year escalation

empty.title: No price schedules yet
empty.message: Add a schedule period to layer multi-year pricing onto this contract.
empty.scheduled_message: Future-dated schedules will appear here once added.
empty.active_message: The contract is using header pricing — no schedule is in effect right now.
empty.superseded_message: Schedules whose window has passed will be archived here.
empty.cancelled_message: Schedules cancelled before activation will appear here.

form.name: Schedule Name
form.name_info: Human-readable label for this pricing window. Often a year or renewal label.
form.description_placeholder: Optional details about this pricing window...
form.supplier_contract_info: The supplier contract this pricing window applies to. Schedules are scoped to a single contract.
form.date_start_info: When this pricing window takes effect. Window is half-open: start is inclusive.
form.date_end_info: When this pricing window ends. Leave blank for the open-ended last bucket. Window is half-open: end is exclusive.
form.currency_info: ISO 4217 currency for prices in this schedule.
form.location_info: Optional location override. Defaults to the parent contract's location.
form.status_info: Lifecycle state. New schedules default to Scheduled and progress to Active when their window arrives.
form.notes_placeholder: Internal notes about this pricing window...
form.notes_info: Internal remarks only. Not visible to the supplier.

confirm.delete_message: Are you sure you want to delete this schedule? This action cannot be undone.
confirm.activate_message: Activating this schedule will supersede any currently-active schedule on the same contract. Continue?
confirm.supersede_message: Mark this schedule as superseded? Future cycles will fall back to header pricing or to the next active schedule.
confirm.cancel_message: Cancelling this schedule prevents it from ever activating. This action cannot be undone.

info.open_ended: This schedule is open-ended (no end date). Only one open-ended schedule is allowed per contract.
info.active_notice: This schedule is currently in effect for the parent contract.
info.superseded_notice: This schedule has been superseded and no longer affects pricing.
info.overlap_blocked: Schedule windows cannot overlap. Adjust the start or end date so this window fits cleanly between existing schedules.

lines.title: Schedule Lines
lines.empty: No schedule lines yet. Add lines to override per-line pricing for this window.

line_form.supplier_contract_line_info: The line whose unit price is overridden during this window.
line_form.unit_price_info: Per-unit price during this window, in the schedule's currency.
line_form.minimum_amount_info: For Minimum Commitment lines: the floor charged per cycle.
line_form.quantity_info: Optional committed quantity for blanket or minimum-commitment lines.
line_form.cycle_value_override_info: Optional cycle-length override. Most lines inherit the contract cycle.
line_form.cycle_unit_override_info: Optional cycle-unit override (day, week, month, year).

detail.title: Schedule Detail
detail.audit_empty_message: Activity logs for this schedule will appear here.

validation.end_before_start: End date must be after start date
validation.overlap_with_existing: This window overlaps an existing schedule on the same contract
validation.open_ended_already_exists: Only one open-ended schedule is allowed per contract
validation.active_already_exists: Another schedule is already active on this contract

errors.permission_denied: You do not have permission to perform this action.
errors.invalid_form_data: Invalid form data. Please check your inputs and try again.
errors.cannot_delete: Cannot delete — this schedule is currently active or has dependent lines.
errors.in_use: Cannot delete — this schedule is referenced by existing records.
errors.overlap_detected: Schedule windows overlap; adjust dates and retry
